name: Steamed Peeled Parsnip Puree (Fork-Mashed)
whyItWorks: Parsnips are naturally sweet root vegetables. Once peeled and simmered until soft, they mash into a velvety puree that acts as a gentle, low-residue alternative to mashed potatoes.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Peel skin with a peeler, cut out any tough woody center core, and boil for 15 minutes. Mash with olive oil or broth.
watchOuts: Discard the central woody core of large mature parsnips before boiling.
